title: Senlin Ascends
author: Bancroft, Josiah
review:
This was a great read, pacing was just right. Got a good balance of world building, character development, and the plot clips away at a steady pace where it's clear that we're making progress towards a larger ending. A weak point was that the action writing wasn't as clear as I would have liked at the end and things got a bit muddled, but prior to that didn't have any issues with the writing and I think in particular the structure of the book is really well done where Bancroft is slowly revealing aspects of the world and characters that make you more invested and not overwhelmed.

Excited to see where the plot goes from here! Really easy to read and I sort of flew through this one unintentionally which is a good sign.
